# House of Shakti

House of Shakti is a yoga sanctuary and boutique retreat house in Santa Teresa,
Puntarenas, Costa Rica, on the Nicoya Peninsula, five minutes from Playa Hermosa.

## What it offers

- Daily yoga classes in an open-air shala, open to all levels, bookable per class
  or as a class pack.
- Yoga retreats hosted by House of Shakti, and retreats hosted by visiting
  facilitators from around the world.
- A 100-hour Tantra yoga teacher training leading to Yoga Alliance RYT 200.
- The Shakti Experience: a packaged stay of a week, a few days, or a length and
  set of activities chosen by the guest.
- Private hire of the whole property for groups hosting their own retreat.
- On site: yoga shala, ice bath, sauna, saltwater pool, jungle setting.

## Where guests sleep

- Main House Suite — up to 10 guests, four suites, each with a private bathroom.
- La Casita — up to 3 guests, one bedroom, kitchen and terrace.
- Jungle Bungalow — up to 2 guests, one bedroom, private bathroom.
- Shakti House — up to 4 guests, two bedrooms, two bathrooms.

## Booking

Accommodation is booked through the Cloudbeds engine linked from every page.
Yoga classes and class packs are booked on the site. Retreats, teacher trainings
and private group hire are arranged over WhatsApp at +506 8560 5115.
